title: Meta made a Tamagotchi-like wearable for its Muse AI agent | TechCrunch
summary: But that hasn’t stopped Meta from jumping into the arena with its own AI wearable, called Muse Charm, which is designed to give consumers another way to stay connected to its recently launched, and already popular, personal AI agent, Muse.
